pages.text: Long ago, people began building structures much bigger than simple homes.
In Egypt, workers carefully stacked giant stone blocks to build pyramids.
The pyramids were built thousands of years ago and still stand today.
Far away in China, workers built a very long wall across mountains and hills.
The Great Wall helped protect cities and required many years of work.
In ancient Rome, builders created strong roads that connected cities across long distances.
These roads made travel and trade faster and easier.
Building large projects required planning, tools, and many skilled workers.
Ancient engineers learned how to measure, lift, and move heavy materials.
These great structures remind us that teamwork and careful design can create amazing things.
